findings.title: Linear-oracle residual does not certify irreducible feature error
findings.source_claim: 1-linear-oracle AUROC represents irreducible error for all feature-based detectors; large model has >5% universal residual.
findings.suspect_step: Restricted affine-score performance is treated as a ceiling for all feature scores.

check.type: analytic proof and exact finite pair enumeration
check.assumptions: Fixed supervised representation h(x)=x; ID labels are sign(x), perfectly separable; original claim imposes no excluded support assumption

findings.counterevidence: A proxy is valid descriptively; identical feature laws would cause true limits. Actual ImageNet Bayes error not established.
findings.impact: Substantial invalid inference in central quantitative irreducible-error decomposition; does not falsify reported scores or entire conceptual warning.

repair.statement: Relabel as linear-probe residual and withdraw universal error-floor interpretation
repair.verified: Logical interpretation repair; no real-data numerical repair claimed

findings.title: Infinite ID sample size does not by itself imply OOD-relevant posterior concentration

check.result: ID likelihood independent oftheta2; posterior remains prior for alln; persistent MI=1-h2(1/4)=0.1887218755bits

continuous_proper_prior.result: For every ID dataset, posterior(theta2)=prior. At OOD(0,1), predictive probability=1/2; MI=1-Eh2(sigmoid(theta2)) >= (1-h2(sqrt3/(1+sqrt3)))/2 > 0.

findings.impact: Invalid unrestricted collapse premise supports the core epistemic-uncertainty rationale in Section 5.3 and the data-size/method guidance in Section 6. Finite Laplace results survive but do not reduce this claim-level severity.

repair.statement: State required identification and posterior-concentration conditions; do not infer universal monotone AUROC decline
repair.verified: Counterexample analytic; conditional repair not empirically rerun

findings.severity_basis: Demonstrated invalid derivation directly supporting a core contribution; no whole-paper failure, score reduction, or difficult repair is required.

findings.title: Documented released reproduction path has entry and input-routing blockers

check.method: Static AST and call-signature reasoning only
defects: Guard compares __name__ to main rather than __main__
linear_oracle captured by logit branch lacking call

findings.impact: Released documented CLI is not a complete functioning evaluation path as written; no claim it generated published values.

repair.statement: Correct guard, pass parsed directory, disambiguate oracle routing and supply separate OOD training features
repair.verified: Local control-flow/signature fixes justified; end-to-end repair not executed or certified
